Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner discounted Henry III’s first coronation on 28 October 1216 as merely an “emergency anointing” and chose 17 May 1220 as the “primary” date. The question asks when John’s eldest son was crowned, which refers to the first coronation in 1216; the later 1220 re-coronation does not negate the 1216 crowning.
